description_en: Updates the deduplication rule for property messages reported by devices under a product. The update takes effect immediately
description_zh: 更新产品下设备上报属性消息的去重规则。即时生效

name: UpdateProductFilterConfig

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html

parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product. The ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a new product. You can view the information about all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html

parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to deduplicate messages based on the property reporting time. Valid values:

- **true**: Deduplicates property messages that have the same timestamp reported by the device.

- **false**: Does not deduplicate messages based on the timestamp
parameters.help_zh:
是否根据属性上报时间进行消息去重。可选值：

- **true**：对设备上报的时间戳相同的属性消息进行去重。

- **false**：不根据时间戳进行消息去重
parameters.name: property_timestamp_filter

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to deduplicate messages based on the property value. Valid values:

- **true**: Deduplicates messages that have the same property value reported by the device.

- **false**: Does not deduplicate messages based on the property value
parameters.help_zh:
是否根据属性值进行消息去重。可选值：

- **true**：对设备上报相同属性值的消息进行去重。

- **false**：不根据属性值进行消息去重
parameters.name: property_value_filter
